name: Brick-based Volume Raycasting
definition: A volume rendering approach that decomposes the volume data into small, fixed-sized data bricks to achieve high cache coherency without increasing memory usage dramatically, unlike spread memory layouts which increase memory usage by a factor of four.
summary: Brick-based volume raycasting decomposes data into fixed-size bricks to ensure high CPU cache coherency and nearly constant rendering performance regardless of viewing direction.
